title: Crochet Laptop Sleeve
description: A padded-feel sleeve with a simple flap that protects your laptop and slips easily into a bag.
expectationText: A practical tech accessory that teaches measuring, sturdy fabric, and a simple closure.

steps.title: Measure the laptop
steps.instruction: Measure the width, height, and thickness of your laptop so the sleeve fits with a little ease.

steps.title: Crochet the body panel
steps.instruction: Work a dense rectangle or folded panel wide enough for the laptop and long enough to wrap around it.

steps.title: Check the fit
steps.instruction: Fold the fabric around the laptop and adjust before finishing the last rows.

steps.title: Join the sides
steps.instruction: Seam or slip stitch the sides, keeping the sleeve snug but not tight.

steps.title: Add the flap and closure
steps.instruction: Finish the top flap and add a loop or button closure that is easy to open and close.

steps.title: Reinforce and finish
steps.instruction: Weave in ends and press the seams flat so the sleeve slides in and out of a bag smoothly.
